burst: Own HP decreases every second while ATK and Charge Speed increase. If own HP dips below 40%, Mode B is removed.

caveats: ⚑ skill2 trigger: the kit says 'when hitting a target with Full Charge'; the schema has no full-charge trigger kind. Encoded as shotFired because A2 is an RL whose every round is a charge shot (chargeFrames 60) — one pull = one full-charge hit. If the engine ever fires uncharged RL rounds, this OVER-fires.
⚑ skill2 rider is on-HIT, not on-FIRE: shotFired dispatches at the pull, so the 30.1% rider lands ~0 frames early instead of at impact. No landing-delay is modeled (delaySec unmeasured).

⚑ burst Mode B duration is kit-silent: no 'for N sec' clause. Set to 15s to match the skill1 window; the real bound is the HP-drain race (3.99% current HP/sec until <40%), which v1 cannot model (no HP pool).
⚑ burst Mode B is a persistent MODE, not a timed buff — modeled as a burstCast-triggered timed self-buff. If Mode B in fact persists until the HP floor, the real uptime is longer than 15s.
partsDamagePct is parsed but inert in v1 (partless scope-lock boss) — kept for kit completeness, contributes zero damage.
Explosion Radius has no schema stat and is NOT projectileExplosionPct (that is a damage stat, this is a hit-area stat) — mapping it to a damage stat would fabricate damage. Skipped.
FB-by-timing left default ON for the 30.1% rider (noFb unset, per the measured-only rule). No core (kit text does not say 'core strike'). crit left default.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. A2 (a2), RL/Fire/Attacker/Burst III, cd 40s, ammo 6, chargeFrames 60. Skill 1 is a burst-cast self window (charge damage + explosion radius, 15s). Skill 2 is a per-full-charge-hit package: a 30.1%-of-final-ATK rider plus a 3s Damage-to-Parts self buff (inert on the partless boss). Burst is a self 'Mode B' trading current HP per second for ATK ▲15.19% and Charge Speed ▲35.88%; the HP drain and its <40% self-removal are unmodeled (v1 has no HP pool), so Mode B is encoded as a timed self-buff with a ⚑ duration. Charge Speed is a WEAPON-STATE modifier and IS damage (it gates charge shots fired) — deliberately not skipped.

flags.reasoning: The burst block states NO duration. Its real bound is the HP-drain race to the 40% floor, which v1 cannot simulate. 15s is taken from the sibling skill1 window (the only duration the kit states) so the two self windows co-terminate — a convention, not a measurement. Arithmetic check: 3.99% of CURRENT HP per second decays geometrically (0.9601^t); reaching 40% takes ln(0.4)/ln(0.9601) ≈ 22.5s from full HP, so the true Mode B ceiling is ~22s if A2 takes no other damage — but the fight's own chip damage would shorten it. 15s sits inside that range and is deliberately conservative.
flags.recipe: Record one A2 fight; frame-count from the burst banner to the frame her charge-fill visibly slows (Charge Speed drop) or her ATK-buff icon clears. Cross-check against her HP bar hitting 40%. If Mode B survives past ~22s, the drain is not on current HP or she is being healed — re-derive.

flags.reasoning: Kit-silent trigger identity: 'when hitting a target with Full Charge' has no schema kind. A2 is RL with chargeFrames 60, so every round IS a full charge — pulls and full-charge hits are 1:1, making shotFired the faithful cadence. It is nonetheless an ON-FIRE proxy for an ON-HIT event, and it assumes no uncharged/tap firing.
flags.recipe: Popup-count one magazine (ammo 6): if exactly 6 extra ~30.1%-of-ATK popups appear per magazine, the 1:1 mapping holds. If the sim can fire A2 uncharged (check whether the engine ever releases an RL below full charge), the trigger must gain a full-charge gate instead.

flags.estimate: one 30.1%-of-final-ATK hit per trigger pull; ~6 per magazine, reload 111 frames + 60 charge frames per shot
flags.reasoning: Cadence tuple is datamine-unreliable per the ALWAYS-⚑ taxonomy (chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 111 both come from the datamine). The rider's total contribution is directly proportional to shots fired, and Charge Speed ▲35.88% from her own burst RAISES that shot count — so this flag and the burst flag interact multiplicatively.
flags.recipe: Count A2's actual shots over a 180s fight from footage (ammo-counter ticks), compare to the sim's shot count with and without Mode B active. Any mismatch localizes to chargeFrames or to the charge-speed formula, not to the 30.1% value.
